note: Inputs on the machine that produced the processed data. Re-running the pipeline downloads the same products from these URLs.

rad_l2.product: MSL RAD Level 2 observation dosimetry, CDF v04
rad_l2.variable: DOSIMETRY_TOTAL[:, 2] (detector E), records with FLAGGED_DATA removed

rems_modrdr.processing: 180 evenly spaced records per sol, PRESSURE bytes 345-351, PS_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL bytes 362-369 (shadow-affected dropped); cached per sol as JSON with source URLs

terrain.product: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m v3 (USGS Astrogeology)

terrain.note: exact affine conversion deg->m on 3396190 m sphere; values are areoid heights

terrain.product: MSL Gale Merged Orthophoto Mosaic 25cm v3 (USGS Astrogeology)
